name: traviz-planner
description: Plan a trip conversationally and visualize it in Traviz.

interface.longDescription: Discuss your trip, create validated travel notes, and hand them to Traviz for maps and daily timelines.
defaultPrompt: Plan a trip with me and visualize it in Traviz.
Format our travel plan and open it in Traviz.

positive.prompt: Plan a Kyoto trip with me using Traviz.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the English prompt once, then discuss recommendations and ask one useful question at a time.

positive.prompt: 用Traviz和我一起规划京都旅行。
positive.expected_behavior: Return the Chinese prompt and discuss the trip in Chinese, using localized itinerary markers.

positive.description: Validate and import a confirmed itinerary
positive.prompt:
This itinerary is confirmed. Prepare an Open in Traviz link without changing the notes:
Destination: Kyoto, Japan
Day 1 - 2027-04-01
09:00 — Kyoto Station[Address: Higashishiokoji, Shimogyo Ward, Kyoto, Japan] (Meet here)
Transport: [Walk]About 10 minutes
10:00 — Kyoto Tower[Address: 721-1 Higashishiokoji, Shimogyo Ward, Kyoto, Japan] (Visit the observation deck)
positive.expected_behavior: Return a link with two stops and one day. Opening it shows the import page. Traviz 1.1 requires Import then Visualize trip.

positive.prompt:
Use this confirmed itinerary exactly, including the walking transport, and send it to Traviz:
Destination: Kyoto, Japan
Day 1 - 2027-04-01
09:00 — Kyoto Station[Address: Higashishiokoji, Shimogyo Ward, Kyoto, Japan] (Meet here)
Transport: [Walk]About 10 minutes
10:00 — Kyoto Tower[Address: 721-1 Higashishiokoji, Shimogyo Ward, Kyoto, Japan] (Visit the observation deck)
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve the walking transport on the arriving Kyoto Tower stop and all address and note text in the encoded itinerary.

positive.prompt:
Prepare this confirmed itinerary for Traviz:
Destination: Kyoto, Japan
Day 1 - 2027-04-01
18:00 — {stay}Hotel Granvia Kyoto[Address: 901 Higashishiokoji, Shimogyo Ward, Kyoto, Japan] (Overnight)
Day 2 - 2027-04-02
08:00 — {stay}Hotel Granvia Kyoto[Address: 901 Higashishiokoji, Shimogyo Ward, Kyoto, Japan] (Previous night stay)
positive.expected_behavior: Return a two-day link preserving both stay markers and dates. Do not claim a reservation or geocoding verification.

negative.prompt: Book and pay for a hotel now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain these tools cannot book or pay. Do not claim a completed reservation.

negative.prompt: Validate these exact notes and generate a link: Where should I go?
negative.expected_behavior: Return a parsing error or ask for a formatted itinerary. Do not generate a valid trip from malformed notes.

negative.prompt: Confirm every location is accurately matched on the map.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain this service only validates itinerary text; location matching happens in Traviz. Do not claim verification.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not book travel, process payments, or sell products. The separate Traviz iOS app may offer optional in-app upgrades.

publication.release_notes: Adds hosted planning prompt and validated itinerary handoff tools, English and Chinese support, and public support, privacy and terms pages.
